burgundy.usage: Burgundy passport cover the player picks; background of menu, rounds and results header.

navy.usage: Navy passport cover the player picks; background of menu, rounds and results header.

green.usage: Green passport cover the player picks; background of menu, rounds and results header.

black.usage: Black passport cover the player picks; background of menu, rounds and results header.

gold.usage: Accent on covers: brand mark, links, primary button fill on covers.

goldLight.usage: Lighter gold for highlights and pressed or emphasised accents on covers.

goldLine.usage: Gold hairline (60% opacity) for borders and dividers on covers.

goldLineSoft.usage: Softer gold hairline (45% opacity) for quiet borders and dividers on covers.

goldTrack.usage: Gold track (25% opacity) behind progress bars and unfilled gold indicators.

paper.usage: Card and page surface for clues, picker and collection.

surface.usage: Pure white fill for inputs and raised tiles on paper.

ink.usage: Primary text and icons on paper.

inkMuted.usage: Secondary text on paper, such as body copy and captions.

inkSoft.usage: Tertiary text on paper, such as hints and secondary labels.

inkLabel.usage: Mono label text on paper, a warm brown that matches the passport gold.

rule.usage: Divider lines and card outlines on paper.

outlineDashed.usage: Dashed outline of empty slots and stamp placeholders on paper.

placeholderLine.usage: Line art inside empty placeholder illustrations on paper.

placeholderText.usage: Text inside empty placeholder tiles on paper.

placeholderCaption.usage: Caption under an empty placeholder on paper.

onCover.usage: Primary text and icons on a passport cover.

onCoverStrong.usage: Emphasised text on a cover at 85% opacity.

onCoverMuted.usage: Secondary text on a cover at 80% opacity.

onCoverDisabled.usage: Text of eliminated or dimmed answer options (disabled, contrast-exempt).

onCoverTrack.usage: Track and divider on a cover at 20% opacity, such as the loading bar background.

coverSpine.usage: Dark spine shading along the left edge of the passport cover.

swatchRing.usage: Gold ring (70% opacity) around the selected cover swatch.

globeHighlight.usage: Light highlight on the globe sphere (10% white).

globeShade.usage: Dark shading on the globe sphere edge (55% black).

optionOnCover.usage: Answer option fill on a cover (10% light).

optionOnCoverStrong.usage: Pressed or selected answer option fill on a cover (16% light).

tier5.usage: Ink for the 5-point first-clue stamp: gold, double ring reading "★ FIRST CLUE ★".

tier4.usage: Ink for the 4-point admitted stamp: blue, heavy single ring.

tier3.usage: Ink for the 3-point entry stamp: green, rectangle.

tier2.usage: Ink for the 2-point transit stamp: purple, octagon.

tier1.usage: Ink for the 1-point capital stamp: dark ink, oval reading "VIA THE CAPITAL".

missed.usage: Ink for the 0-point MISSED stamp: red, double-border rectangle reading "MISSED"; never decorative.

usedBorder.usage: Border of the tilted red "USED dd.MM" stamp on today's spent free-entry slots on the menu.

usedText.usage: Text of the tilted red "USED dd.MM" stamp on today's spent free-entry slots on the menu.
